description: This is a React functional component for a login page implementing a two-step login flow: first collecting email to fetch user organizations, then prompting for organization and password to authenticate. It manages various UI states, performs API calls, handles navigation after login, and enforces tenant salt validation.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on email input when user submits the email form.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process, including validation, API call to login, handling INACTIVE_TENANT error, storing session token, and redirecting.
